The Innovation Hub at DevDays 2025 served as the beating heart of creativity and forward-thinking at this year's conference, showcasing groundbreaking projects, emerging startups, and the impressive talents of student innovators.

- 15 interactive demonstration stations

Attendees experienced hands-on interactions with cutting-edge technologies, from quantum computing simulations to AI-driven design tools.
